title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: Travel Benefits and Purchase Protection
summary: Explains Business Bronze Rewards Card international use and purchase protection: foreign transaction fee is 2.75% on the converted amount for purchases outside the U.S. (including non‑USD merchants). Also covers disputing undelivered goods/services—start promptly, provide documentation—and notes rewards are reversed if a transaction is refunded.
faqs: What is the foreign transaction fee when I use my Business Bronze Rewards Card outside the U.S.?
If a merchant abroad charges in USD, does the 2.75% foreign transaction fee still apply?
What should I do before traveling to reduce the chance my card is declined?
How do I initiate a dispute if goods aren’t delivered or services aren’t provided as agreed?
What documents should I provide when disputing a travel or lodging purchase?
What happens to my rewards if the disputed transaction is refunded?
